(Mīmāṃsā) The rule that of the various matters resulting
 from something, only the most important one is {#prayojaka#} while the
 rest are not {#prayojaka#}. This rule is established by {#jEmini#} and
 {#Sabara#} discussing the text, <ls>MS. 4. 1. 22-24</ls>.
